title: Post-Training with Policy Gradients: Optimality and the Base Model Barrier
abstract: arXiv:2603.06957v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study post-training linear autoregressive models with outcome and process rewards. Given a context $\boldsymbol{x}$, the model must predict the response $\boldsymbol{y} \in Y^N$, a sequence of length $N$ that satisfies a $\gamma$ margin condition, an extension of the standard separability to sequences. We prove that on test samples where the base model achieves a non-trivial likelihood $\alpha$, a variant of policy gradient (PG) can achieve likelihood $1 - \varepsilon$ with an essentially minimax optimal number of reward queries $\tilde{O}((\alpha^{-1} + \varepsilon^{-1})/\gamma^2)$. However, a barrier arises for going beyond the support of the base model. We prove that the overall expected error after post-training with outcome rewards is governed by a property of the base model called the Likelihood Quantile (LQ), and that variants of PG, while minimax optimal, may require a number of reward queries exponential in $N$ to g

translated_title: 基于策略梯度的后训练：最优性与基座模型障碍
translated_abstract: 我们研究使用结果奖励和过程奖励对线性自回归模型进行后训练的问题。给定上下文 $\boldsymbol{x}$，模型需要预测响应 $\boldsymbol{y} \in Y^N$，这是一个长度为 $N$ 的序列，满足 $\gamma$ 间隔条件，这是标准可分性对序列的扩展。我们证明，在基座模型达到非平凡似然 $\alpha$ 的测试样本上，策略梯度（PG）的一种变体可以实现似然 $1 - \varepsilon$，且所需的奖励查询次数基本达到极小极大最优，即 $\tilde{O}((\alpha^{-1} + \varepsilon^{-1})/\gamma^2)$。然而，在超越基座模型支持范围时会出现障碍。我们证明，使用结果奖励进行后训练后的总体期望误差由基座模型的一个属性——似然分位数（LQ）——决定，并且策略梯度的变体虽然达到极小极大最优，但可能需要指数于 $N$ 的奖励查询次数才能...
tldr: 本文证明策略梯度后训练在基座模型支持范围内可达到极小极大最优，但超越基座模型支持范围时存在指数级查询障碍，总体误差受似然分位数控制。
en_tdlr: This paper shows policy gradient post-training is minimax optimal within the base model's support, but faces exponential query barriers beyond it, with overall error governed by the Likelihood Quantile.
